subject: Hosted API integration — architecture deep-dive scheduling & SDK/streaming agenda

Subject: Hosted API integration — architecture deep-dive scheduling & SDK/streaming agenda

Hi Samira / Ben —

Thanks again for the interest in Redwood. As discussed in our discovery call, the next best step is a focused architecture deep-dive to align on integration approach (Hosted API + SDKs), streaming behavior for live transcription, and tool/function-calling for EHR lookups.

Proposed outcomes:
- Confirm integration pattern (server-side SDK vs direct API)
- Latency/throughput targets for your busiest endpoints
- Network and security checklist for private data flows
- Action items and owners for a pilot (PoC)

Availability: I can do 30–60m slots on Tue/Wed afternoon PST. Ben / Samira — can you share preferred times? If it helps we can do a 45m working session with a short 15m follow-up.

I attached a short agenda and a rough architecture sketch — please review quickly if you can.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0198

- redwood-hosted-arch-agenda.pdf (agenda, 2 pages)
- architecture-sketch.png (sketch, 800x600)

Tue afternoon works for us. Two windows that look good on our side:
- Tue 24 Nov, 1:00–1:45pm PST
- Tue 24 Nov, 3:30–4:15pm PST

We'd like Rishi (your infra lead) to walk the SDK deployment options and discuss token handling. Also want to include a short section on streaming behavior — Samira will bring the use case (real-time notes + occasional EHR enrichments).

I don't see the attachments in my client (might be a corporate filter). Could you re-send the agenda as a spreadsheet and include any network port requirements?
